ValidationRule.description: Once a value is selected in the field " Is Hardship Resolution Letter Sent?" and saved, then this cannot be changed back to Blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Customer_Complaint", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Non_Customer_Complaint" ), NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED( IDR_Is_Hardship_Resolution_Letter_Sent__c ), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(IDR_Is_Hardship_Resolution_Letter_Sent__c)))), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Is_Hardship_Resolution_Letter_Sent__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once a value is selected in this field and saved, then this cannot be changed back to Blank.
